purpose: Teach: 可動/一団/電通/テコ/使節/敷設/全貌/国内線

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、可動式実験台の使い方を覚えろ
lines.en: Ren — learn how to use the mobile experiment table.
lines.style: Direct, measured instruction. Calm authority without harshness. Clear enunciation on the name, then a slight pause before the task. Matter-of-fact tone.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究員を一団で学会に派遣します
lines.en: Yes. I'll arrange to send the research team to the conference.
lines.style: Quick affirmation, then quiet focus. Speaking more to himself than to Hiroshi — already thinking through logistics. Slight forward lean in the intention.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、電通系広告会社のインターンも経験しろ
lines.en: Ren — make sure you get experience with an advertising internship at a Dentsu-affiliated firm.
lines.style: Same steady authority as the first. Direct eye contact. Deliberate pacing. Each task given with the weight of opportunity, not burden.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。データ分析にテコ入れします
lines.en: Understood. I'll develop the data analysis side during that time.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment, but the second sentence reveals his mind already working on application. Slight quickening as he commits to the challenge.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、海外学術使節として派遣される機会を活かせ
lines.en: Ren — when you have the chance to go abroad as an academic envoy, make full use of it.
lines.style: Slight shift to encouragement here — still directive, but with the hint that this is a rare opportunity. Warm firmness underneath. Brief pause before 'abroad'.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究設備の配線敷設も学びます
lines.en: Yes. I'll also learn how to lay and manage the research equipment wiring.
lines.style: Earnest affirmation, slightly breathless as his mind expands the scope. Each 'also' signals he's taking the instruction seriously — maybe too seriously. Small smile at his own thoroughness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究分野の全貌を捉えろ
lines.en: Ren — grasp the full picture of your research field.
lines.style: Finalizing instruction. Slower, heavier. The most important thing said last. 'Grasp' lands with quiet weight. Direct and almost fatherly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。国内線で学会移動を計画します
lines.en: Yes. I'll plan out conference attendance across domestic routes.
lines.style: Close affirmation with finality. Still earnest, but a sense of wrapping up — he's taken it all in. Slight exhale at the end. The 'yes' carries the full weight of the responsibilities just assigned.
